_source: Azure list prices, Global Standard. Verify before relying on these for anything user-facing; regional and Data Zone deployments cost more.
_precedence: An LLM row in the database always wins. This file only covers models DARE routes but does not itself offer.
_unpriced: Azure does not sell Anthropic, Google or Meta models, so us.anthropic.*, gemini/* and us.meta.* cannot be priced from an Azure list. Add an LLM row, or extend this file from the vendor that actually serves them (Bedrock / Vertex).
gpt-5-mini, gpt-5.4-nano and gpt-4o-transcribe had no published per-million rate at the time of writing.
